_comment: Purpose-specific EXTENSION fields, layered on top of the 44-field base schema in assumption_schema.json. The base schema is never repeated here and is never modified — each purpose lists ONLY the extra assumptions that purpose genuinely needs. Bank Loan is deliberately empty: it is fully served by the base 44 fields, so its behaviour is byte-identical to before this file existed. Extension fields have no `cell` mapping because the CMA workbook has no input cells for them; they are produced by the AI as purpose context (the mapper passes unmapped keys through untouched). Give an extension field a `cell` only once a template actually has an input cell for it.

Bank Loan.description: Bank term-loan / CMA appraisal. Fully covered by the base 44 fields (DSCR, MPBF, ratios all derive from them). No extensions — do not add any without a template cell to write them into.

Feasibility Study.description: Go/no-go viability appraisal. Judged on discounted returns (NPV/IRR/payback) over the project's life, not on debt service — so it needs a discount rate and a horizon the base schema does not carry.

additional_fields.label: Discount rate (WACC)
additional_fields.description: Weighted average cost of capital used to discount future cash flows, as a decimal fraction (e.g. 0.14 = 14%). Reflect the actual debt/equity mix and Indian cost of capital for this industry.

additional_fields.label: Project life
additional_fields.description: Economic life of the project used for NPV/IRR, typically 10-20 years for manufacturing, shorter for asset-light businesses.

additional_fields.label: Terminal growth rate
additional_fields.description: Perpetual growth beyond the projection horizon, as a decimal fraction. Must be modest (typically 0.02-0.04) and never exceed the discount rate.

additional_fields.label: Downside sensitivity
additional_fields.description: Adverse swing applied to price/volume in the sensitivity case, as a decimal fraction (e.g. 0.10 = a 10% downside scenario).

Government Grant.description: Subsidy / capital-subsidy scheme appraisal. The grant changes the funding structure and the effective project cost, so the subsidy mechanics must be explicit.

additional_fields.label: Scheme name
additional_fields.description: The specific subsidy scheme applied for (e.g. PMEGP, CLCSS, a State capital subsidy). Use the user's stated scheme if given.

additional_fields.label: Subsidy percentage
additional_fields.description: Share of eligible project cost the scheme reimburses, as a decimal fraction (e.g. 0.25 = 25%).

additional_fields.label: Subsidy cap
additional_fields.description: Absolute ceiling on the subsidy amount under the scheme, regardless of the percentage.

additional_fields.label: Eligible capex
additional_fields.description: Portion of project cost that qualifies for subsidy (typically plant & machinery; land is usually excluded).

additional_fields.label: Grant release year
additional_fields.description: Projection year (1-5) in which the subsidy is actually received in cash. Most schemes disburse after commissioning, so this is rarely Year 1.

Venture Capital.description: Institutional equity round. Judged on ownership, valuation and exit return, not on debt service.

additional_fields.label: Funding amount sought
additional_fields.description: Equity capital being raised in this round.

additional_fields.label: Pre-money valuation
additional_fields.description: Company valuation immediately before this round. Must be consistent with equity_offered and funding_amount_sought.

additional_fields.label: Equity offered
additional_fields.description: Ownership stake given to investors in this round, as a decimal fraction (e.g. 0.15 = 15%). Must equal funding_amount_sought / (pre_money_valuation + funding_amount_sought).

additional_fields.label: Valuation method
additional_fields.description: Basis of the valuation (e.g. 'Revenue multiple', 'DCF', 'Comparable transactions').

additional_fields.label: Exit multiple
additional_fields.description: Expected exit valuation as a multiple of the exit-year metric (revenue or EBITDA). State which in valuation_method.

additional_fields.label: Expected exit year
additional_fields.description: Projection year in which investors expect a liquidity event (typically 5-7).

Angel Investment.description: Early-stage individual equity. Same shape as VC but smaller, with founder dilution as the headline concern.

additional_fields.label: Funding amount sought
additional_fields.description: Equity capital being raised from the angel investor(s).

additional_fields.label: Pre-money valuation
additional_fields.description: Company valuation immediately before this investment.

additional_fields.label: Equity offered
additional_fields.description: Ownership stake given to the angel, as a decimal fraction. Must equal funding_amount_sought / (pre_money_valuation + funding_amount_sought).

additional_fields.label: Founder dilution
additional_fields.description: Reduction in founders' combined ownership caused by this round, as a decimal fraction.

additional_fields.label: Expected exit year
additional_fields.description: Projection year in which the angel expects an exit or secondary sale.

Immigration Business Plan.description: Investor-visa business plan. The immigration authority judges job creation and committed investment, not lender ratios.

additional_fields.label: Visa program
additional_fields.description: The specific program the plan supports (e.g. EB-5, E-2, UK Innovator Founder, Canada Start-up Visa). Use the user's stated program if given.

additional_fields.label: Investment commitment
additional_fields.description: Capital the applicant commits to inject, as required by the program's threshold.

additional_fields.label: Local employment target
additional_fields.description: Number of qualifying local jobs the business commits to create (e.g. 10 for EB-5).

additional_fields.label: Employment creation year
additional_fields.description: Projection year by which the full employment target is met (programs usually require this within 2-3 years).

additional_fields.label: Promoter net worth
additional_fields.description: Applicant's declared net worth, evidencing lawful source of the invested funds.

Internal Business Planning.description: Management's own plan. No external party to satisfy — the question is growth, expansion timing and target margins.

additional_fields.label: Strategic growth rate
additional_fields.description: Management's targeted annual revenue growth beyond the base capacity ramp, as a decimal fraction.

additional_fields.label: Expansion capex
additional_fields.description: Additional capital investment planned during the projection period, over and above the initial project cost.

additional_fields.label: Expansion year
additional_fields.description: Projection year in which the expansion capex is incurred.

additional_fields.label: Target operating margin
additional_fields.description: EBITDA margin management is steering towards by the end of the projection, as a decimal fraction.

Real Estate.description: Property development / rental. Revenue is driven by saleable area and absorption, not by units of production — these fields carry that structure.

additional_fields.label: Saleable area
additional_fields.description: Total saleable / leasable built-up area of the project.

additional_fields.label: Sale price per sqft
additional_fields.description: Expected realisation per saleable square foot at current prices.

additional_fields.label: Absorption rate
additional_fields.description: Share of saleable area sold/leased per year, as a decimal fraction (e.g. 0.30 = 30% of inventory absorbed annually).

additional_fields.label: Construction period
additional_fields.description: Months from project start to completion, during which there is capex but little or no revenue.

additional_fields.label: Rental yield
additional_fields.description: Annual rent as a fraction of asset value, for any portion held rather than sold. Set to 0 for a pure sale model.

Startup & SME Fundraising.description: Early-stage raise judged on runway and burn, not on profitability or debt service.

additional_fields.label: Funding round
additional_fields.description: Stage of the raise (e.g. 'Pre-seed', 'Seed', 'Series A').

additional_fields.label: Funding amount sought
additional_fields.description: Capital being raised in this round.

additional_fields.label: Monthly burn rate
additional_fields.description: Net monthly cash outflow at the start of the projection (gross costs less any revenue).

additional_fields.label: Runway
additional_fields.description: Months the raised capital funds operations at the stated burn rate. Must be consistent with funding_amount_sought / monthly_burn_rate.

additional_fields.label: Customer acquisition cost
additional_fields.description: Sales and marketing spend required to win one paying customer.
